violation_type.title: Private Water Supply Meets Requirements of TCEQ (26 TAC §746.3431(2))
violation_type.short_title: Private Water Supply Meets Requirements of TCEQ
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated and compliance was not met. The operation does not have written records from the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality stating the water supply meets their requirements.
